                    buckets.put(diff, buckets.getOrDefault(diff, 0) + 1);
                    sum += diff;
                } else if (sum < B) {
                    sum += diff;
                    buckets.put(diff, buckets.getOrDefault(diff, 0) + 1);
                    count++;
                    start = i + 1;
